description: QA one email before it sends, using the team's house rules: HTML structure, Outlook conditionals, Gmail clipping, alt text, links (non-production hosts, unsubscribe, UTMs, approved domains), personalization rendered for several synthetic personas, subject line, sender, brand terms, spelling variant and required footer text. Pass HTML or a local file path. Read-only; sends nothing.

check_links_live.description: Also check each link over the network (HEAD requests only; unsubscribe and click-tracking links are never requested).

file.description: Absolute path to a local .html file, used when html is not given.

html.description: The email HTML, including template tags.

personas.description: Synthetic test profiles. Leave empty to use the team's personas or auto-generated ones.

attributes.description: Attribute values keyed by path, e.g. {"first_name": "Ana", "custom_attribute.loyalty_tier": "Gold"}

platform.description: Which platform's template language the email uses.

transactional.description: Receipts, password resets and other transactional mail: skips the unsubscribe requirement.

name: check_email
title: Check an email
